candidate.assembly: One ADM1175 controller, one exact Kelvin shunt, and one external N-channel FET per independent loop
manufacturer_supported_facts: VCC operating range 3.15-16.5 V covers the HPQ4 12 V source range
VLIM is specified 97-103 mV over the stated operating conditions
external N-channel FET gate drive and sense resistor are required
fast overcurrent response is 4-10 us and is guaranteed by design, not production tested
I2C voltage/current readback and TIMER fault behavior are documented
Kelvin sense connection is recommended for low-value high-current shunts

gate_review.requirement: Each of six loops guarantees 6.000-6.400 A over component, supply, process and temperature tolerances
gate_review.evidence: The screening calculation yields 6.0037330222-6.3961705444 A only under an assumed 16.13 mOhm, 0.1%, 10 ppm/C shunt; exact shunt and production residual are not established.

gate_review.requirement: Complete limiter path is no greater than 57 mOhm hot
gate_review.evidence: The assumed shunt consumes up to 16.1566145 mOhm, leaving 40.8433855 mOhm for external FET, copper, Kelvin interconnect and other series terms; no exact FET or installed hot bound is qualified.

gate_review.requirement: External FET is safe at actual minimum gate drive and fault waveform
gate_review.evidence: ADM1175 requires an external N-channel FET; no exact production MPN, hot RDS(on) at the actual gate drive, VDS/transient rating, SOA or I2t coordination is bound.

gate_review.requirement: Reverse, surge, fault and shutdown behavior is a complete six-loop contract
gate_review.evidence: The datasheet documents current-limit, fast-trip, TIMER and retry/latch mechanisms but does not provide a PiSXMe reverse-polarity/reverse-current policy, clamp, harness-inductance waveform, fuse/TVS coordination or V100 inhibit/reset truth table.

gate_review.requirement: Thermal installation and production calibration/test are qualified
gate_review.evidence: Controller operating and junction limits are component facts; FET/shunt/copper temperature rise, six-loop fixture limits, calibration residual, retention and lot traceability remain undefined.

required_to_resume: Select exact ADM1175 variant and exact production Kelvin shunt MPN/package with tolerance and tempco evidence.
Select exact external N-channel FET and prove hot RDS(on) at worst-case ADM1175 gate drive, VDS/transient, SOA and I2t.
Close the complete installed <=57 mOhm hot path including shunt, FET, copper and Kelvin interconnect.
Define reverse-current/reverse-polarity, surge, clamp, fuse, harness and six-loop fault coordination.
Define thermal installation limits and a production calibration/test fixture with residual, retention and traceability limits.
residual_dependency.resume_action: Requalify the exact assembled limiter through Power, nFET, protection, thermal, harness and production-test authorities; only then release source-contract and CAD work.

sources.role: prior binding limiter authority and residual dependency

validation.method: Decimal re-evaluation of manufacturer Equations 1-3 and resistor screening assumptions; no bench or fabricated-hardware result
assertions: all unresolved gates remain explicitly open

signature.decision: ADM1175-1ARMZ-R7 and ADM1175-2ARMZ-R7 remain candidate architectures only; no production limiter is promoted.
signature.signature_basis: HPQ4 v2.0.0, Librarian ADM1175 primary-source brief/index, Analog Devices ADM1175 Rev. C datasheet, and current prior limiter authority.
signature.authority_boundary: Binding limiter qualification disposition only; no CAD insertion, product-envelope reduction, or source-contract release.
